_schema.description: Impurity species for the ISS extension (impurity extension): CO, CH4, N2, He-3, He-4. Every value carries its source. Values marked '本工作拟合' are DERIVED (regressions against NIST REFPROP saturation data) and must not be cited as literature values. See the impurity-property provenance record for the full audit.

freezing_assessment.CO: T_tp = 68.16 K >> window: solid. True criterion at trace level is solubility (~0.2-0.3 ppm for N2 in LH2 at 20 K); freeze-out/plugging hazard. See A2 report.
freezing_assessment.N2: T_tp = 63.15 K >> window: solid. Measured solid-N2 formation 29.8-32.9 K (Barwood et al. 2025).
freezing_assessment.He3: supercritical/non-condensable (T_c = 3.32 K); trace to the top.
freezing_assessment.He4: supercritical/non-condensable (T_c = 5.20 K); trace to the top.

operation_window.note: Declared demonstration-basis acceptance ('99% of impurities leave via the top vent') is physically valid only for He; CO/CH4/N2 freeze out at 19-30 K. Flagged in the impurity disposition documentation.

kij_status.note: Per the declared demonstration basis: list sources, do not change numbers. EPA/600/7-87/004 Table 8 gives SRK kij (H2-N2 0.1016 / H2-CO 0.0904 / H2-CH4 0.0050, Lin convention; CH4-N2 0.0319, GD convention) - convention-bound, NOT to be mixed with COMSOL SRK(GD). H2-T2 and all T2 pairs: not found; literature uses Sherwood excess-function models. Keep kij = 0 with source comments until conventions are unified.
